name: Sonda S.A.
summary: Sonda S.A., together with its subsidiaries, provides information technology (IT) solutions in the United States, Canada, Chile, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Ecuador, Guatemala, Panama, Uruguay, Costa Rica, Mexico, and Peru. It operates through Digital Business, Digital Services, and Transactional Business segments. The company offers digital software factory, digital architecture, and data and advance analytics, as well as network and edge, DaaS and IaaS, cloud and datacenter, cybersecurity, workplace services, and technology infrastructure and services.
